title: Crestline Summit Club Membership Terms — Joining, First-Year Price and Start of Membership
content:
## 1. Who may join

1.1 A Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships lounge membership is opened only for a customer with an open Summit membership who is at least the youngest holder age set for the chosen membership.

1.2 A lounge membership is opened only when the customer's Summit membership status is enrolled, active or dormant. This is read from the status recorded on the customer's own Summit membership, before the lounge membership is opened.

1.3 A Summit Club Corporate membership is opened only when a corporate travel agreement in active status pays for it.

| Requirement | Where it is shown | Met when |
|---|---|---|
| Open Summit membership | The status on the customer's Summit membership record | The status is enrolled, active or dormant |
| Age | The customer's age | At least the youngest holder age of the chosen membership |
| Paying agreement (Summit Club Corporate only) | The status of the corporate travel agreement that pays for it | The agreement is in active status |

All requirements that apply to the chosen membership must be met for it to be opened.

## 2. First-year price

2.1 The first year's price is the membership's annual dues, less the membership's Summit Gold and higher dues discount for a member whose Summit tier is Summit Gold or higher.

2.2 The first year's price may be paid with the membership's Summit miles price for one year of dues instead, when miles payment is permitted for that membership. It is never paid with a Crestline flight credit.

2.3 A Summit Club Lifetime membership costs its lifetime purchase price, once.

2.4 Prepaying the number of membership years that may be prepaid at once reduces each year's dues by the membership's prepayment discount percentage.

The annual dues, the Summit Gold and higher dues discount, the miles price and whether miles payment is permitted, the lifetime purchase price, the number of years that may be prepaid and the prepayment discount are each set per membership of the Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships range.

### Worked figures (hypothetical amounts, for illustration only)

| Hypothetical inputs | First-year price |
|---|---|
| Annual dues 800 USD; Summit Gold and higher discount 80 USD; member is Summit Gold | 800 USD less 80 USD, that is 720 USD |
| Same membership; member's Summit tier is below Summit Gold | 800 USD |
| Same membership; miles payment permitted with a miles price of 50000 miles | The year may instead be paid with 50000 Summit miles |

Prepayment, hypothetical: annual dues of 1000 USD, 3 years prepaid at once, a prepayment discount of 5 percent, member without the Summit Gold and higher discount. Each year's dues are reduced by 5 percent of 1000 USD, that is to 950 USD; the three prepaid years total 2850 USD.

## 3. Start of membership

3.1 The membership becomes active once its first charge is settled. Until then it is pending. A membership granted as a benefit becomes active when it is granted and starts.

3.2 The membership runs one membership year — the number of calendar months set for the membership — from its start date to its renewal date.

Illustration (hypothetical dates, a membership year of 12 calendar months): a membership whose start date is 15 March 2026 has a renewal date of 15 March 2027.
